actual_image.observed_layout: 8 columns x 4 rows, but cells are 256x512 because the model returned a square canvas

pros: front and back rows have some foot-motion variation
identity and outfit are visually close to the target character
issues: Gemini ignored the requested 2048x1024 output and returned 2048x2048
side rows flip facing direction between columns, so they are not continuous left/right walk cycles
several frames change backpack visibility and head orientation too much for smooth animation
opaque white background still needs cutout
not suitable for final RPG import without heavy manual reconstruction
motion_review.smooth8_conclusion: 8 frames can be smoother only when each row preserves direction and phase order. This candidate proves that Gemini can add more leg poses, but it does not reliably maintain side-facing continuity in 8-frame rows.

recommendation: Do not default the skill to 4x8 final output. Default to multiple 4x4 full-sheet candidates for layout reliability. Use 4x8 Gemini output as motion reference only, or generate a single side row and mirror/rebuild it deterministically if smooth visible walking is required.
